name: The Depths of the Marion Crypts

text.offer: Beneath Marion's crypt, past the resting place of its ancestors, there are deeper chambers: the Affirmation of the Forsaken, and the laboratory of the mad brothers. Something they made down there still lives - thrashers, horrors of claw and muscle. Kill eight. Take friends: this is no task for one.
text.progress: The thrashers haunt the deepest chambers of the Marion crypts: the Affirmation of the Forsaken and the laboratory of the mad brothers.
text.complete: Eight thrashers. Whatever those brothers made, it will think twice before crawling out.
